body:
So basically I was at the dentist, which I avoid going to at all cost and hadnt been to since I was like 17, having some fillings done. Without it I just couldnt deal with having all these things in my mouth. Anyways, it was a very strange experience. I had the mask over my nose and the dentist ask if I was feeling anything did she need to turn it up, and I said yeah because I cant breathe real good up my nose, so she turned it up and almost immediately it was too much so she turned it back to normal.
I cant report seeing anything because I had my eyes closed during the whole thing not wanting to see what they were doing to me. But I noticed that even though I was hearing people talking, in the office, and outside in the waiting room, that the sounds were softer
sounds were softer
, almost like it was all on tv. I was going through things in my head, just basically trying to distract myself from the work in my mouth, and thinking about daily plan, etc. I realized all these plans were stupid, and that life really meant nothing at all, and that there was no point in doing anything. It was really quite depressing, and on the way home I thought about it and wondered if centuries of religious leaders who wanted to just throw the world away felt the same. Obviously, after a good long nap, I didnt feel that way anymore.
